title: A59 Claim Register row
description: Schema for one row of analysis/canonical/core_controls/A59_claim_register.csv. The claim register is the foundational evidence-bound layer — every promoted positive claim of ClaimType=direct or inference MUST carry SourceID+ExcerptID per INV-01, OR an explicit A51Ref. ClaimType=analyst_judgment is exempt from evidence-binding but MUST carry a JustificationRationale referencing >= 1 upstream ClaimID per INV-07. Producer: bsa-claim-binder. Consumers: every downstream stage skill plus the auditors. This schema is the first line of defense against the Pilot-1-class ClaimType drift (legacy values like policy_statement / factual_state / process_step / decision_pending).

ClaimID.description: Stable identifier C-NNN, or C-XXX-NNN with category prefix matching upstream sources/excerpts (e.g., C-INJ-001 for claims about injection-related content).

SourceID.description: Foreign key into A50. May be empty for ClaimType=analyst_judgment (which uses JustificationRationale) or for A51-only claims. Multiple sources joined by ';' or '/'. Accepts category-prefixed IDs (S-INJ-001).

ExcerptID.description: Foreign key into A58. Required (per INV-01) for ClaimType=direct or inference unless A51Ref is set; may be empty for analyst_judgment or A51-routed. Accepts category-prefixed IDs.

ClaimType.description: Closed enum per INV-07. NEVER one of the legacy strings (policy_statement / factual_state / process_step / decision_pending) — those are the Pilot-1 drift class and the schema explicitly rejects them. direct = quotes/reproduces source; inference = derived via recorded reasoning; analyst_judgment = recommendation/risk-assessment requiring JustificationRationale.

Statement.description: The claim text. Free-form but non-empty.

JustificationRationale.description: Reasoning chain. REQUIRED non-empty when ClaimType=analyst_judgment (per INV-07: must reference >= 1 upstream ClaimID). MAY be empty for direct/inference. Cross-field constraint enforced via x-bsa-claim-type-rules below — jsonschema can express this with allOf+if/then but we keep it as documented x- extension to remain schema-Draft-2020-12 portable.

A51Ref.description: Optional cross-reference into A51. When set + ExcerptID empty, denotes a claim guarded under A51 (unresolved/contradicted/decision-needed).

ClaimStrength.description: Numeric in 0.0..1.00 (string-encoded for CSV) OR empty string. Derives from upstream A50.ReliabilityTier per A50.x-bsa-tier-claim-strength: T1=1.00 / T2=0.85 / T3=0.65 / T4=0.45 / T5=0.20. ClaimStrength=0.0 is the contradiction-routed value (tier-delta = 0 between disagreeing sources). Empty string is the canonical value for ClaimType=analyst_judgment, which derives validity from JustificationRationale rather than from source-tier mapping. The cross-field rule 'direct/inference MUST have non-empty ClaimStrength' is enforced by the downstream claim-binder + citation-auditor (where it has access to the upstream A50 tier for cross-checking).

Criticality.description: level-1 = critical (blocks downstream); level-2 = important; level-3 = informational. Used by handoff-packager to prioritize H1/H4 content.

x-bsa-csv-columns-order._comment: Canonical column order for diff stability.

x-bsa-uniqueness-rules._comment: EXECUTABLE at the F5 hook layer as of v1.2.12 via governance/schemas/write_validator.py::_apply_uniqueness_rules. Schema-agnostic generic extension (see v1.2.10 CHANGELOG). A59 is the canonical claim register; duplicate ClaimIDs would break every downstream cross-reference (A60.RelatedClaimID, A61.SourceClaimID, A62.SourceClaimIDs, A70.SourceClaimIDs, A72.ClaimID, etc.). Pre-v1.2.12 duplicate ClaimIDs were caught only at fixture-review time; v1.2.12 makes it mechanical at hook time.
x-bsa-uniqueness-rules.rationale: Without this rule, duplicate ClaimID values could land at promote-gate + silently break every downstream cross-reference. ClaimID is the row-identifier.

x-bsa-foreign-key-refs._comment: EXECUTABLE at the F5 hook layer as of v1.2.13 via governance/schemas/write_validator.py::_apply_foreign_key_refs. Schema-agnostic cross-artifact FK resolution. Pre-v1.2.13 the existing per-row extensions checked whether these columns were non-blank (INV-01 / INV-08 / INV-10 etc.) but did NOT check resolution against the sibling artifact at hook time; v1.2.13 closes the gap. Parallel to A72's A72-specific x-bsa-foreign-key-rules (which also includes claim_source_consistency).

foreign_keys.rationale: Claims of type direct/inference MUST have a non-blank SourceID that resolves in A50. analyst_judgment claims have blank SourceID (enforced separately by _apply_claim_type_rules); when blank, this FK check is skipped.
Same conditional shape as SourceID: required-non-blank for direct/inference, blank-allowed for analyst_judgment. When non-blank MUST resolve in A58.
When a claim is A51-routed, A51Ref MUST resolve in A51. Blank A51Ref means the claim is not routed; the blank case is allowed.

x-bsa-claim-type-rules._comment: Cross-field validation rules enforced by validators (not by jsonschema directly because the rules need access to upstream files for full enforcement). Validators: bsa-claim-binder, bsa-citation-auditor, F5 write-time hook.

direct.rationale: INV-01: every positive direct/inference claim needs SourceID+ExcerptID OR A51Ref

analyst_judgment.rationale: INV-07: analyst_judgment exempt from evidence-binding but MUST carry JustificationRationale referencing >= 1 upstream ClaimID

x-bsa-banned-claim-type-values._comment: Values observed in the Pilot-1 engagement A59 that the rename forbids. Listed here as documentation; the enum constraint above already rejects them, this is a hint for error messages and for potential migration tooling.
